workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text:
Hi Brad, thanks for checking. I've compared our two lists and indeed there appears to be no overlap between when Priya/Marcus are free and when Elena/David are free. 

Before we report this as infeasible, could you please provide me with Elena Soto's complete free times and David Okafor's complete free times for next week (not just their overlap)? I want to manually verify each slot against Priya and Marcus's calendars to be absolutely certain there's no possibility of a 30-minute slot where all four can meet. I want to make sure we haven't missed anything before reporting infeasible.
